title: Mathematics Refresher
description: A friendly refresher of the maths you actually use at work and in business, with worked examples in Kenya shillings. Ideal for school leavers preparing for jobs, college, a side hustle or aptitude tests.
outcomes: Work confidently with fractions, decimals and percentages
Calculate discounts, percentage change, profit and profit margins
Compare loans and savings using simple and compound interest
Use ratios, proportions, averages and unit conversions in everyday tasks
Read tables and graphs and make quick estimates
Set up and solve simple equations for real problems
